terms.gloss: a thin plate of metal: a baking tray
evidence: Caes. BC 2.10: eaque lāminīs clāvīsque religant
Plin. NH 34.94: aes in lāminās tenuāre (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically a thin plate of metal, wood, or stone (see “sheet metal”); its use for the tray that goes into the oven is modern, and ours. Where it must be clear, lāmina ferrea.

phrases.latin: Crustula in lāminā dispōne, nē sē tangant.
phrases.english: Lay the biscuits out on the baking tray so they don’t touch.
